title: Rainbow Springs Paddle Craft Rentals
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: What sets this rental apart? The right gear, local knowledge, and three full hours to soak in one of Florida's most beautiful rivers. Choose a crystal-clear kayak for a window straight down into the Rainbow River's famously clear water, or go with a stable sit-on-top kayak, classic canoe, or paddleboard — all beginner-friendly and perfect for families. Before you launch, we'll share insider tips a guidebook can't give you: where the otters have been playing, the best side creeks to explore, and the prime spots to stop, wade, and snorkel in the 72-degree spring water. With three hours on the water, you'll have time to paddle toward the headsprings, drift back with the gentle current, and linger wherever the river wins you over. Easy booking, friendly local service, and a launch right on the Rainbow — it doesn't get better.
